# Seamless ATS Integrations

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/62d6d36f5e0c51ac7e3267b9/660d652a80b69757af6ca988_04-24-speak-ats-integration.png)

We've been hard at work ensuring that our platform is accessible to _everyone_. We're excited to announce seamless integrations with several leading ATS platforms, including Greenhouse, Ashby, and Workable, with more on the way soon.

With ATS integration, you can now:

- Automatically rank all applicants for any role from your ATS
- Quickly access candidates' profiles within your ATS directly from Speak\_
- Manage candidates through the hiring pipeline without leaving our platform

Interested in what else we've been up to? [Check out our latest updates here.](https://speak.careers/updates)
